notes.text: Conditional set-theoretic check: with I finite and each D_i closed, the exact-incidence set I(x)=J is the closed intersection of the D_j, j in J, minus the finite union of the other D_i. It is therefore open in that closed intersection and locally closed in X. This supports the compatibility of the newly recovered marginal inclusion sign with the stated support, without proving the page’s regularity claim.

The independent audit leaves the last index in the second display uncertain: the preferred transcription has a bare final D, with D_j retained only as an alternative because the terminal curve is crowded against the parenthesis. It also restores the raised contraction after codim and the uncertainty on on; none of these readings is supplied from the expected formula or grammar.
